Value

A value fetched from outside the program: absent until it arrives, able to fail, and able to arrive again. T is the fetched type. Reading one is four accessors — three independent facts and the combination almost every screen wants: if users.loading() { spinner() } for var u = users.or([]) { row(user = u) } A fetched box comes from query and nothing else; the three constructors below make the settled, failed and pending states directly, for an adapter that already has its answer and for a test that needs to render one branch. A bare T is not a Value<T> and does not become one on its own — a Value carries fetch state that no plain value implies.

Methods

  • error — How the most recent attempt failed, or null if it succeeded.
  • failed — True when the most recent attempt failed.
  • inFlight — True while an attempt is in flight.
  • loading — True when there is nothing to show yet: an attempt is in flight and no value has ever arrived.
  • or — The value if one has arrived, otherwise fallback.
  • ready — True when a value is available, whether or not the most recent attempt failed.
  • refresh — Re-runs the fetch behind this box, bypassing any cached answer.
  • value — The most recent value that arrived, or null if none ever has.
